g.text: Define benchmark contracts and metric meanings
Separate raw sink, creation, and full CQRS paths
Add CPU, concurrency, batch, and stream-length matrices
Add warmup, duration, repeats, confidence, and metadata
Fix repeat isolation, error propagation, and stable schema
Add command, projection, snapshot, cache, and failure journeys
Exercise memory, SQLite, Pebble, and optional Postgres
Expose reproducible suites and machine-readable artifacts
Capture CPU, heap, mutex, block, and execution traces
Run targeted, race, lint, build, and representative benchmarks
Stabilize API and tag only after evidence
